title: Étale clopen partition with connected geometric fibre traces
statement: Let f : X → S be a proper morphism of schemes and let s ∈ S. There exist an étale morphism g : U → S and u ∈ U over s, and finitely many pairwise disjoint clopen opens V_i of X ×_S U covering it, such that the inverse image of each V_i in the geometric fibre over u is connected (and hence nonempty). The empty family is allowed.

source.place: Tag 0BUI, proof: Stein factorization, Tags 03H2, 0E0M, and 0BSR

proof.text: Restrict around s to an affine base and apply affine Stein factorization. Its integral second map has finite point fibres and finite residue extensions by the Stein-fibre lemma. Apply integral fibre étale splitting to obtain an affine étale pointed neighbourhood and a finite clopen partition of the pulled-back Stein factor.

Pull the clopen partition back along the first Stein map. After algebraic closure of the residue field at the pointed base point, each piece has exactly one point because its residue extension is purely inseparable. The corresponding fibre of the geometrically connected first Stein map is connected and nonempty; fibre-product associativity identifies it with the inverse image of the piece in the geometric fibre. Thus the pulled-back pieces have connected traces and cover the geometric fibre.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_etale_geometricFiber_clopen_partition
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (s : S) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ S) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g u = s ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (V : Fin m → (pullback f g).Opens),
        (∀ i, IsClosed (V i : Set ↥(pullback f g))) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (V i) (V j)) ∧ (⨆ i, V i) = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ i, _root_.IsConnected
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (U.residueField u)
              (AlgebraicClosure (U.residueField u)))) ≫ U.fromSpecResidueField u) ⁻¹'
            (V i : Set ↥(pullback f g)))
